title: Replace knee actuator (sim procedure)
disclaimer: Training/demo procedure. Values and hardware details are placeholders, not Unitree service instructions.

steps.title: Power down
steps.text: Power down the robot and isolate the battery before service.

steps.title: Open the leg
steps.text: Remove the leg cover to expose the knee actuator and harness.

steps.title: Disconnect harness
steps.text: Disconnect the actuator harness and inspect the connector.

steps.title: Remove knee actuator
steps.text: Remove the knee actuator using the simulated service sequence, then install and reconnect the replacement.

steps.title: Calibrate
steps.text: Run encoder calibration, then run the stand cycle and verify that tracking error stays below the alert threshold.
